_comment: Charter player text. Copied to config/charter/en_us.json on first boot; edit that copy. Placeholders in braces are filled in. A refusal can be reworded by adding reason.<key>.

justice.nobody: Nobody is in custody or held. Use a lead on someone standing on your land to arrest them.

justice.row_execute: Execute: a wait of {wait}, then banished for {banish}.

justice.link_fine_hover: Fine {player}; refused if they hold no coin
safe.closed: The personal safe is closed. A custody fine is paid from the prisoner's own coin.
chronicle.players_only: Only a player can be handed a book.

book.item.name: Charter of Rights and Freedoms
book.item.lore: Use it to see where you stand.
book.given: You have been given the Charter of Rights and Freedoms. Use it, or type /charter, to see where you stand.
book.newcomer.title: You belong to no faction
book.newcomer.soon: Founding and joining are coming to this book.
book.home.title: {org}
book.nexus.unnamed: Name a banner at an anvil and craft it with a lodestone: its name becomes your faction's.
book.found.done: {name} is founded. Its keep stands here. It needs a second member before it is more than a name.
book.newcomer.intro: Ask to join a faction, or found your own.
book.merc.title: Mercenary
book.merc.intro: A mercenary takes a race and wields its weapons, but belongs to no kingdom, holds no land and answers to no one. Mercenaries are on their own unless they group up, and anyone can be attacked anywhere.
book.merc.rules: Choose with care: you cannot choose again. Joining a kingdom makes you of its race, unless its charter lets in every race.
book.merc.done: You are a mercenary of the {race} race.
book.freedoms.mixed_open: {org} lets in every race, and members keep their own.
book.freedoms.mixed_closed: Joining {org} makes you a member of the {race} race.
book.merc.none: There is no race to take yet.
book.join.title: Join a faction
book.join.none: No factions yet. Found your own.
book.join.more: More factions exist than are listed here.
book.join.runs_keeps: The same hands run the keeps and the rest.
book.rights.none_ruled: You hold no powers of your own here. Your ruler decides, and you can ask them for a seat or a power.
book.faction.keep_plain: Keep at {x}, {z}. It is permanent and needs no food.
book.tip.you: Powers you hold yourself. You may use them without asking anyone.
book.tip.office_one: An office is a seat that carries powers. {name} holds it now and acts for the faction.
book.tip.office_any: An office is a seat that carries powers, held by several people. Any one of them may act on their own.
book.tip.office_together: An office is a seat that carries powers, held by several people. A majority of them must agree before anything is done.
book.tip.vote: Nobody holds this power. The members decide it together by vote.
book.tip.player: This power was given to one player, to use for the faction.
book.tip.org: This power was given to another organization.
book.tip.form_commune: A commune has no ruling seat. Every member votes on what matters and the majority decides. Nobody rules alone.
book.tip.form_lordship: A lordship has one ruler, the Lord, who holds the ruling seat and acts alone. Members do not vote on everyday matters.
book.tip.form_council_alone: A council has a fixed number of ruling seats. Any one council member may act on their own. Other members do not vote.
book.tip.form_council_together: A council has a fixed number of ruling seats. The council members decide together, so a majority of them must agree. Other members do not vote.
book.freedoms.no_vote_set: Your ruler is named by the server's operators. You can leave this kingdom.
book.join.no_vote_set: The server's operators name each kingdom's ruler. Members can leave.
book.freedoms.no_vote: You cannot vote the ruler out or change how this faction is run. You can leave, or break away.
book.join.no_vote: Members cannot vote the ruler out. They can leave, or break away.
book.join.commune_rule: The members decide together, by vote.
book.holder.vote_newcomer: The members, by vote (you could vote once you are a member)
book.join.waiting: You have asked. Waiting for their answer.
book.found.title: Found your own
book.found.intro: A faction begins as a Nexus, placed where its keep will stand.
book.found.step_craft: Craft the Nexus from the lodestone and the banner
book.found.step_place: Place it where your keep should stand
book.found.cooldown: You founded a faction too recently. Wait {time}.
book.faction.vote_later: You can vote on changes in {time}.
book.faction.election_council: An election for {office} is open among the council that stepped down. Its members choose who keeps the seat.
book.seats.proposed: Put to the {office}. It passes when most of them agree.
book.war.title: War
book.war.intro: A nation goes to war for one thing: to capture another nation's outpost. Keeps are never taken.
book.war.need_outpost: You need a raised outpost of your own before you can declare war. A war is fought between your outpost and a neighbouring rival outpost that touches it.
book.war.no_targets: No rival outpost touches one of yours, so there is nobody to fight. Plant your outpost beside theirs.
book.war.against_waiting: {org} declared war on your outpost {site}. Nothing can be done to it for {time}.
book.war.against_open: {org} may now try to take your outpost {site}. If they hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of your people in it, it is theirs. Stand in it to stop them. The war ends in {time}.
book.war.by_waiting: You named {site} of {org}. Capture cannot begin for {time}.
book.war.by_open: Capture of {site} of {org} is open. Hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of their people in it. The war ends in {time}.
book.war.truce: A truce with {org} holds for {time}. Neither of you may declare on the other.
book.war.confirm: Declare war on {org}: your outpost {from} against their outpost {site}?
book.war.confirm_skin: The war is between those two outposts, which touch. Your other outposts are not in it. If your outpost is lost, the war ends.
book.war.confirm_notice: Nothing can be done to their outpost for {hours} hours. Then your people must hold its chunk for {minutes} minutes with none of theirs in it. The war ends after {total} hours.
book.war.confirm_lapse: If it ends with nothing taken, neither nation may declare on the other for {days} days. If you take it, you get its deposit and the banner comes down.
book.war.declared: War is declared. Both nations were told.
reason.war_not_a_nation: Only a nation declares war, not a sub-faction.
book.form.council_alone: A council of {count}, any one may act
book.rights.title: Your Rights
book.rights.intro: What you may do on your own in {org}.
book.rights.none: You hold no powers of your own here. Your say is your vote.
book.freedoms.title: Your Freedoms
book.freedoms.intro: What others do for {org}, and who decides.
book.freedoms.none: Nothing is held for you by anyone else.
book.limit: up to {n} Marks at a time
book.holder.vote_you: The members, by vote (you can vote)
book.holder.vote_not_yet: The members, by vote (you cannot vote yet)
book.situation.title: Your situation
book.situation.owed: The treasury owes you {list}; it arrives when you have room.
book.vote.title: A vote
book.vote.gone: That vote is no longer there.
book.faction.keep_low: The granary lasts {days} more days. Feed it, or the keep's claim lapses.
book.faction.no_keep: This nation holds no keep. Put a Nexus down to claim land again.
book.faction.who_decides: Propose a change to who decides
book.faction.election_opened: An election is open. Cast your ballot.
book.reject.title: Turn away?
book.decides.title: Who decides
book.decides.locked: The server sets how this kingdom is run for now, so it cannot be changed here.
book.decides.intro: A commune is run by its members, so changing how it is run is their vote.
book.decides.proposed: Put to a vote of the members.
book.decides.own: You hold this office, so you may change how it is run yourself.
book.decides.size_alone: How many seats? Any one holder may act.
book.decides.size_together: How many seats? A majority of the holders must agree.
book.decides.only: {now}. Only {who} decide this. You cannot vote it, but you can break away.
book.leave.title: Leave {org}
book.leave.confirm: Leave {org}? You cannot undo this. You give up any office you hold there.
book.leave.cooldown: The founding cooldown still applies afterwards: if you founded a faction or broke away in the last {days} days, you must wait before you can found one.
book.breakaway.title: Break away
book.breakaway.sub_vote: It takes a vote: more than half of ALL members who can vote must say yes. Not voting counts as no.
book.breakaway.cost_none: It costs nothing: your faction owns a keep, and it goes with you.
book.breakaway.cost_nexus: After the vote you have {hours} hours to place a Nexus, paid from your faction's own treasury ({price} Marks). If you do not, nothing changes.
book.breakaway.stay: Whoever disagrees cannot stay in {parent}: their only choice is to leave, and then they have no faction.
book.breakaway.pending: The vote passed. {time} left to place a Nexus.
book.breakaway.has_subs: This faction has sub-factions. They leave it one by one, each by its own vote; a group cannot.
book.breakaway.ruler: You rule here. Abdicate first, then you can break away.
book.breakaway.flat_intro: A group of two or more can leave {org} and found a faction of its own. No vote is needed.
book.breakaway.flat_start: Start it, and others who want to come press the same button within {hours} hours.
book.breakaway.cost_diamonds: The one who starts pays {price} diamonds for the keep, from what they carry.
book.breakaway.starter_places: They name a banner at an anvil, craft it with a lodestone into a Nexus, and place it away from every keep.
book.breakaway.proposed: Put to a vote of your faction's members.
book.breakaway.cooldown: Afterwards nobody who comes along can found or break away again for {days} days.
book.breakaway.confirm_vote: Put breaking away to a vote of your members?
book.breakaway.confirm_group: Break away from this faction with the group?
book.calendar.seasons: The year has four seasons: {seasons}. Each lasts four weeks.
book.calendar.days: A week is seven days and a day is a real day. The Chronicle dates things by day, week and season.
admin.menu.title: Charter Admin
admin.menu.intro: Operator tools for the kingdoms. Each button runs the same command you could type under /charter admin, and is written to the siege log the same way.
admin.menu.console: This opens a menu on a player's screen. From the console, type the command itself: /charter admin <command>.
admin.menu.denied: Only operators may use the admin menu.
admin.menu.form_bad: That form could not be read. Open the page again.
admin.kingdoms.title: Kingdoms
admin.kingdoms.none: There are no kingdoms yet. Make one with New kingdom.
admin.kingdom.is_admin: An admin kingdom: closed to new members, no claim cap, no keep upkeep.
admin.leader.title: Appoint a leader
admin.leader.intro: Pick an online player. They join {kingdom} and become its only Lord, replacing any Lord now seated.
admin.leader.label: Player
admin.bonus.title: Claim bonus
admin.bonus.intro: Extra claims for {kingdom} on top of its member allowance. Now {bonus}.
admin.bonus.label: Bonus claims
admin.bonus.bad: The bonus must be a whole number from -1000 to 100000.
admin.dissolve.title: Dissolve {kingdom}?
admin.dissolve.body: {kingdom}, its sub-factions, keeps and claims are removed for good. There is no undo.

admin.create.intro: Founds an operator-set kingdom with its Nexus at these coordinates. The boxes start at your position.
admin.create.name: Name
admin.create.bad_name: Give the kingdom a name, without the | character.
admin.create.bad_number: The coordinates must be whole numbers.

admin.vote.label: Vote number

admin.give.intro: Puts the item in the player's inventory.

discord.not_running: Charter is not running on the server right now. Try again shortly.

book.duplicate: You can only carry one Charter book, so the extra one was removed.
book.borders.on: Borders shown. Press the button again to hide them.
book.leader.title: Leader's Desk
book.leader.intro: Run your faction. What you see depends on the powers you hold.
book.leader.not_a_leader: The Leader's Desk is for officers of the faction.
book.leader.invite_intro: Pick someone online who belongs to no faction. They join by accepting.
book.leader.invite_none: Nobody online is free to invite.
book.leader.grant_intro: Let an officer or a member use a power for the faction.
book.leader.grant_none: There is nobody to give a power to.
book.leader.nexus_intro: The Nexus moves to where you stand. You must be inside your keep. The keep and its land do not move.
book.leader.form_bad: That choice was not valid. Try again.
book.more.title: More
book.needs.title: Needs you
book.merc.confirm: Become a {race} mercenary? You cannot choose again.
book.stand.title: Where I stand
book.leader.request_gone: That request is no longer there.
book.leader.nexus_inside: You stand inside your keep, so it can move here.
book.leader.nexus_outside: You are not inside your keep. Walk into it first.
book.words.intro: Pick a word to see what it means.
book.words.lordship_text: One ruler, the Lord, holds the ruling seat and acts alone. Members do not vote on everyday matters.
book.words.commune_text: No ruling seat. Every member votes on what matters and the majority decides.
book.words.council_text: A fixed number of ruling seats. Either any one of them may act, or a majority must agree. Other members do not vote.
book.words.keep_text: A nation's home and its land, with the Nexus in the middle. A keep is never captured.
book.words.outpost_text: A camp raised with a war banner beside land nobody holds. It keeps its own food, and it can be captured in a war.
book.words.nexus_text: The lodestone at the heart of a keep. Go to keep takes you to it, and a leader can move it within the keep.
book.words.marks_text: The money of the realm. A treasury holds Marks, and a leader with the power takes them out as coins.
book.words.held_text: A judge of a faction can lock you in a cell or bind you to their keep for a time. It ends on its own, or when you are released or bailed.
book.justice.intro: Pick someone to sentence or release.
book.justice.nobody: Nobody is in custody or held.
book.justice.bail_none: None of your people are held.
book.justice.bail_intro: Your kingdom pays to free one of its people.
book.justice.execute_refused: An execution is not allowed now.
book.justice.cells_none: No cells yet. Stand in your keep where a cell should be, and mark it.
book.justice.cells_intro: Stand where a cell should be, then mark it. Press a cell to remove it.
teleport.bar.keep: Going to your keep. Hold still.
teleport.bar.outpost: Going to your outpost. Hold still.
teleport.bar.hub: Going to the hub. Hold still.
book.ranks.title: Ranks
book.ranks.intro: Every rank of your kingdom, top first. The top rank is always the Lord's; every other member starts at the last one. Pick a rank to rename it, move it or remove it.
book.ranks.not_yours: You cannot change your kingdom's ranks.
book.ranks.top_note: The top rank always belongs to the Lord. It can be renamed (King or Queen, say) and nothing else.
book.ranks.default_note: Every member starts at this rank. It cannot be removed or moved, but it can be renamed.
book.ranks.remove_confirm: Remove the rank of {rank}? Its {n} holders go back to {default}, and any powers it carried end.
book.ranks.removed: The rank of {rank} is gone. Its holders are back at the default rank.
book.ranks.name_intro: Pick a name, or pick "My own" and type one: up to 20 letters, digits and spaces.
book.ranks.no_name: Pick a name or type one.
book.ranks.added: {rank} added, just above the default rank.
book.ranks.give_intro: Pick a member and the rank they hold from now on. A member holds one rank at a time.
book.ranks.give_none: There is nobody to give a rank to yet. The Lord always holds the top rank.
book.ranks.powers_intro: What the rank of {rank} may do: every holder can use these powers for the kingdom. Only powers you hold yourself are offered, and changing the charter, dissolving, appointing and managing ranks are never given to a rank.
book.ranks.toggle_intro: Press a power to turn it on or off for {rank}.
book.tip.rank: This power goes with the rank of {name}: whoever holds that rank can use it.
rank.cmd.head: Ranks of {kingdom}
rank.cmd.no_kingdom: You are not in a kingdom.
rank.cmd.power_off: The rank of {rank} may no longer {power}.
mapmarker.bad_colour: Unknown colour {colour}. Use six hex digits such as FFAA00, or one of: {names}.
mapmarker.refused: That marker was refused. An id is at most 64 characters and a label at most 128; at most 256 markers stand at once.
mapmarker.list_none: No map markers. {players} player(s) receive the kingdom map.
mapmarker.list_head: {count} map marker(s). {players} player(s) receive the kingdom map.
mapmarker.sync_off: mapSyncEnabled is off in charter.json, so nobody is sent the kingdom map.
mapmarker.markers_off: mapSyncMarkers is off in charter.json, so markers are not sent with the kingdom map.
book.tip.form_co_lordship: A lordship with two Lords: they rule together as equals. Either may act alone on everyday matters. Removing a Lord or changing how the kingdom is ruled needs both. Members do not vote.
book.tip.lords: The two Lords hold this power. Either of them may use it alone.
book.seats.proposed_lord: {other} must agree. It is put to them now.
admin.coleader.title: A second Lord
admin.coleader.intro: Pick an online player. They join {kingdom} and rule beside its Lord as an equal. There are never more than two Lords.
admin.unlord.title: Remove a Lord
admin.unlord.intro: The Lord picked loses the seat but stays a member. With two Lords the other rules alone.
